asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
sub     rsp, 20h
mov     [rbp+c1], edi
mov     [rbp+c2], esi
mov     [rbp+state], rdx
mov     edi, [rbp+c1]; uc
call    utf8proc_get_property
mov     [rbp+p1], rax
mov     edi, [rbp+c2]; uc
call    utf8proc_get_property
mov     [rbp+p2], rax
mov     rax, [rbp+p1]
mov     edi, [rax+12h]
shr     edi, 18h
and     edi, 3Fh; lbc
mov     rax, [rbp+p2]
mov     esi, [rax+12h]
shr     esi, 18h
and     esi, 3Fh; tbc
mov     rax, [rbp+p1]
mov     edx, [rax+12h]
shr     edx, 1Eh; licb
mov     rax, [rbp+p2]
mov     ecx, [rax+12h]
shr     ecx, 1Eh; ticb
mov     r8, [rbp+state]; state
call    grapheme_break_extended
and     al, 1
movzx   eax, al
add     rsp, 20h
pop     rbp
retn
